component.name: Sidewing
component.summary: Translucent xbar-style desktop bar for X11

description.p: Sidewing is a small GTK4 desktop bar for X11 multi-monitor Linux desktops. It runs local executable scripts as plugins, parses xbar-style stdout, and renders a translucent bar with per-plugin popover menus.

ul.li: xbar-compatible plugin format with refresh intervals encoded in filenames
Generated form to edit plugin variables declared via xbar.var metadata
terminal=true menu items launch in a detected terminal emulator
Optional autostart via a systemd user unit
